items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: Rag Baby Stevens wasn't on that picture. It was a fella by the name of Swift, was the snare drummer.

ctx.x: And, uh, uh, he, uh, Judge, he, he owned the bakery. Well his son still owns the bakery over there in Gretchen. His son's a lawyer. Oh yeah. And, but they, they, they still own the bakery over there in Gretchen. The son does. I was just talking to him there for yesterday. Uh, he, uh, his daddy gave the picture to my cab. I'll give it to the shrine, band or what, I don't know. But, uh, I know you, you, you, you can, you can see the picture in there. That's, uh, my daddy. And, uh, Rag Baby Stevens wasn't on that…
